Choosing care

How do I know which care service to explore?

Start with the routines where support is needed and any recommendations from the treating clinician. Nursing, physiotherapy and everyday assistance have different roles. Use the service pages to prepare questions, then confirm the appropriate support with a qualified professional.

How are companion care and nursing care different?

Companionship focuses on everyday routines and social support. Nursing involves clinical responsibilities that require the appropriate professional qualifications. Confirm which tasks are needed and who is qualified to carry them out before making arrangements.

Can more than one type of support be discussed?

Yes. A family may need to discuss a combination of practical, personal and clinical support. Agree the responsibilities of each person involved and confirm which services can actually be arranged.

Planning support

Can I plan support before hospital discharge?

You can start the conversation before the return home. Ask the discharge team what needs to be arranged, who is responsible and which follow-up appointments are planned. Confirm the home-care arrangements with the treating team.

What should I have ready for a care conversation?

A short outline of the support needed, preferred timing, everyday routines and questions from the family is a useful start. Keep medical documents private and share them only through a confirmed, appropriate channel when requested by the care professional.

What should be included in a care quote?

Ask for the tasks included, visit or shift length, the role of the person providing support, and any additional charges. Confirm payment, cancellation and rescheduling terms directly before arranging care.

How should family updates be planned?

Agree one main family contact, a preferred way to share updates, what information will be shared and who to contact when questions arise. Ask how changes in the care plan will be discussed.

Availability & contact

Where is care available?

The service area and local availability are still being confirmed for this website preview. Check these details directly with Gentle Hands before making any care arrangements.

How do I contact Gentle Hands?

Direct phone and email details have not yet been supplied for this preview. The Contact page can help you prepare a care note, but it does not send an enquiry or reserve support.

Does preparing a care note make a booking?

No. The note is created in your browser for you to copy or download. Nothing is submitted, no callback is requested and no appointment is booked.

This website

Do I need to enter personal or medical details?

No. The care-note form asks only for a care category and a timeframe. It does not ask for a name, phone number, medical record or address.

Are the photographs and stories real patient experiences?

The caregiver photograph is generated illustrative imagery. The guides contain general planning questions, not patient stories or testimonials. No patient outcomes or personal experiences are claimed.
